act(x) against the dashed identity line. Above it amplifies, below it attenuates — evaluated through the engine itself.
The ceiling is EC50 < 2^(−1/n) — 0.610 at n = 1.4, 0.794 at n = 3. Netflux's own defaults (n = 1.4, EC50 = 0.50) sit safely inside it, which is why the reference
implementation never needed the guard; a high-threshold gate is what walks into it, and this model has three.
